key_insight: System 1 agents select tools and arguments without generating text, achieving high accuracy with no invented content in evaluated calls.
clinical_relevance: Local tool-calling agents could support sensitive clinical data workflows without sending patient data to cloud LLMs.
method: A deterministic compiler converts tool schemas and requests into multiple-choice questions.
Answer options come from the request and tool schema.
A one-pass decision model selects answers to construct tool calls.
evidence_signal: Across 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent achieved 97.0% correct tool selection or decline versus 95.2% for the best local LLM setting, filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values, and produced no invented call content.
watch_item: Benchmark results do not establish safety or effectiveness in real clinical workflows; local deployment still requires validation and data-security controls.
paper_title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
